claims.head: The Senators hit; the Predators mostly don’t
claims.body: On physicality, Ottawa is one of the league’s best and Nashville is one of the league’s worst. That’s about as far apart as two teams get.
claims.gist: The Senators and the Predators sit at opposite ends for physicality.
claims.call: The Senators hit more than the Predators in the close stretches of the game.

claims.head: The Senators hunt better looks than the Predators
claims.body: The Senators are near the top of the league for shot quality, at the dangerous end; the Predators are one of the league’s worst, at the hopeful end. Expect that gap to show.
claims.gist: The Senators and the Predators sit at opposite ends for shot quality.
claims.call: The Senators’ shots are more dangerous on average than the Predators’.

OTT.head: The matchup suits Ottawa
OTT.body: Ottawa has controlled the play far better over recent games and has home ice. Nashville’s way back in is a power play that gets going.
